name: EPIC 211658621

text.card: A red giant 1,555 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 1.05 solar masses and 7.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,757 K at its surface.
